messages:
Maya: Quick poll — building a roadtrip playlist + a single binge-watch for next week. Drop 1 movie/TV show and 1 track or book that pairs weirdly but works. I'll collect for the office carpool 🚗
Ellie: The End of the F***ing World (TV) + "Siegfried" — Bon Iver. Moody & weirdly soothing. :ok_hand:
Jon: Ooh. My pick: Mad Max: Fury Road + "A Horse With No Name" (don’t @ me, it fits the desert vibe). :sunglasses:
Sam: Movie: Only Lovers Left Alive + playlist: Velvet Underground — White Light/White Heat side. Night driving energy. 🧛‍♂️🎸
Priya: Book + song: The Secret History (Donna Tartt) + "Genesis" by Grimes. Melancholy campus energy but synth-y. Also +1 for almond croissants.
Maya: Love these. Throwing in a weird combo — TV: Chef's Table S2 + Kishi Bashi — "Manchester" for slow food vibes. Also — anyone want me to queue these in a shared Spotify playlist?
Jon: Yes please. Could you add a note like "roadtrip: 4hrs low-energy first, then peaks at 2:15"? Helps for handoffs.
Ellie: tiny poll: upvote 🙂 or downvote 👎 for "book in the car"? I'm firmly in paperback-only camp.
Sam: upvote 🙂. Audiobooks are allowed if it's a long drive. Also dropping a sample playlist: https://open.spotify.com/playlist/37i9dQZF1DX4WYpdgoIcn6
dev-bot: Reminder: Carpool leaves 9:15 AM next Sat. RSVP in #lunch-plans.
Maya: thanks all — compiling. If you want a weird bingo card I can make one: "song that mentions a fruit" / "movie with a car chase" etc. :laughing:
